config.ratings: Chain.rateOrder(order, worker, score), in the clear: customer wallet, then the order's stealth wallet
config.payloads: late release (pickup key): {items, k} for the establishment; {restaurantId, s} + sealed {deliveryAddress, items} for the worker, read from the Information event
config.pool: one deposit per cycle, merged with the previous change note (the dummy note in cycle 1); payment commitment: the revenue is a note

ethUsd.source: AVAX-USD rate (the native token of Avalanche; the field usdPerEth carries it): Coinbase spot price API, api.coinbase.com/v2/prices/AVAX-USD/spot

run.fees: tip at least 0.00000015 gwei, maximum fee 0.001 gwei
run.orderTotalRule: ORDER_TOTAL_WEI (given); default rule: smallest multiple of 0.001 ETH that is at least 2 x the gas stipend (eth_gasPrice at the start x 2,400,000), at least 0.001 ETH

cost.formula: gas used x effective gas price of each transaction, summed; x the ETH/USD rate
